scope: Post-run receipt/product identity checks, exact heap arithmetic, raw macOS time RSS, complete expected native state membership/length/depth/bytes and source handles. Child receipt identities are observed now, not bound by the batch at completion. Semantic assertions are recorded by R, not independently replayed here. Heap is measured before current inspection, but prior inspection may expose/materialize. Whole-child RSS includes setup, repeated calls and final validation; it is not per-call peak. Heap, native bytes and RSS overlap and must not be added. No full runtime image closure or foreign-write isolation claim.
